description.value:
Cost 1 Bandwidth

Duration sustained

Traits Paradise-Touched, Glimpse, concentrate

Choose a 5-foot cube of unattended, non-magical matter within 30 feet — a section of wall, a door, a patch of floor. For as long as you sustain this, that matter does not exist, leaving an opening. When you stop sustaining it, the matter returns. A creature occupying the space is moved to the nearest space that can hold it and the matter returns anyway; it takes no damage.
